extent_source_note: Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, high confidence): Dense regular grid clearly visible and mostly isolated from town fabric further out; DTM point sits toward south edge of the block, shifted estimate slightly N/NE to better centre on the visible dense grid.

Fixed-radius buffer fallback (300m) - satellite imagery reviewed but no camp-specific structure confidently distinguishable from surrounding built-up area. Site sits within continuous dense Jere/Maiduguri peri-urban fabric with no distinguishable camp-specific boundary; a regular white-roof grid ~150m NW of the point may be relevant but cannot be confidently attributed to this site specifically. Fixed-radius buffer fallback.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, high confidence): Isolated wedge-shaped dense settlement block clearly separated from surrounding farmland by open ground; a secondary dense block ~150m S also visible and included within radius. High confidence.

Fixed-radius buffer fallback (300m) - satellite imagery reviewed but no camp-specific structure confidently distinguishable from surrounding built-up area. Site sits within continuous dense Monguno town fabric with no distinguishable camp-specific boundary. Fixed-radius buffer fallback.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, medium confidence): Distinct regular grid block visible, extending mostly N of the DTM point (point sits near the block's southern edge, consistent with a registration-point-not-centroid pattern); block is contiguous with surrounding town fabric to the E so extent estimate is less certain than isolated-site cases.

Fixed-radius buffer fallback (300m) - satellite imagery reviewed but no camp-specific structure confidently distinguishable from surrounding built-up area. Site sits within continuous dense Monguno town fabric with no distinguishable camp-specific boundary. Fixed-radius buffer fallback.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, high confidence): Distinct regular small-shelter grid pattern (visually different texture from surrounding town) directly at/around the DTM point; a second similar grid block ~300m SW likely a related but separate cluster, not included to keep the estimate conservative.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, high confidence): Isolated roughly circular settlement blob clearly separated from surrounding riverine/farmland terrain; DTM point sits near the N edge of the blob, most of the mass extends S.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, medium confidence): Small distinct regular grid immediately at the DTM point, clearly separated from scattered buildings further E across the road; low absolute footprint count (633) relative to 3,864 recorded households suggests Open Buildings under-detects this rural context, so radius padded beyond the visible grid alone.

Fixed-radius buffer fallback (300m) - satellite imagery reviewed but no camp-specific structure confidently distinguishable from surrounding built-up area. Site sits within a dispersed rural town (Naka) with continuous scattered building pattern in all directions - no distinguishable camp-specific cluster. Fixed-radius buffer fallback.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, high confidence): Very clean, highly regular planned housing grid, clearly isolated from surrounding farmland, DTM point almost exactly centred. Highest-confidence delineation of the 15.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, medium confidence): Modest cluster of structures at the DTM point, separated by a visible gap of open ground from the much larger Dikwa town mass further S - plausible but smaller/less certain than the high-confidence cases.

Imagery-delineated (Esri World Imagery, visual review vs. Google Open Buildings footprint overlay, medium confidence): Small cluster of visually distinct (tan/orange-roofed) structures at the DTM point within dense Makurdi urban fabric; kept to a tight radius given how embedded the site is in the surrounding city.

Fixed-radius buffer fallback (300m) - satellite imagery reviewed but no camp-specific structure confidently distinguishable from surrounding built-up area. Only a handful of structures visible near the DTM point on mostly bare ground, separated from the main Monguno-area town mass; too sparse/ambiguous to confidently distinguish camp extent from incidental structures. Fixed-radius buffer fallback.

Fixed-radius buffer fallback (300m) - satellite imagery reviewed but no camp-specific structure confidently distinguishable from surrounding built-up area. Small cluster at the DTM point embedded in a dispersed rural settlement pattern (Daudu) with no clean boundary distinguishing camp from general town. Fixed-radius buffer fallback.
